metaTitle: Custom Blue Luggage ID Tags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom blue luggage ID tags for easy bag identification. Perfect for corporate gifts and events. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Blue luggage ID tags stand out on baggage carousels, making it simple for your team or clients to spot their bags. Whether you choose a sleek leather tag for executive travel or a durable plastic option for frequent flyers, blue offers a professional yet approachable look. Add your logo with full-color imprint or foil stamping for a polished finish. These tags are ideal for corporate gift sets, trade show giveaways, or employee recognition programs.
heroAltText: Custom blue luggage ID tags with corporate logo, featuring a leather tag and a plastic tag on a suitcase.
